_note: Source of truth for the `main` branch ruleset; apply with `just rulesets-apply`. Keys starting with `_` are notes and are stripped before sending. Personal repo, so no merge queue: `gate` is required with strict up-to-date branches, and auto-merge does the rest. After moving to an organization, add a `merge_queue` rule (SQUASH, ALLGREEN) and set strict_required_status_checks_policy to false.
name: main

parameters._note_code_owner_review: CODE-OWNER REVIEW IS OFF until agents open PRs as a GitHub App: a PR author can't approve their own PR, so turning it on now blocks every PR the owner opens. Then set require_code_owner_review to true and required_approving_review_count to 1.

parameters._note: integration_id 15368 is the GitHub Actions app, so only Actions can report `gate`.
